expected_invariant: A chat-call budget counts SRT text slots, including every line of a multiline cue, before a model run.

minimal_reproducer.observed_wrong_assumption: Four cues were treated as four chat calls, leaving a fictional retry slot.

related_controls.condition: A multiline cue in a middle window contributes each target slot.
A multiline cue in a final window contributes each target slot.

negative_controls.condition: An empty text slot is rejected instead of reducing the count.
A malformed SRT cue is not counted as a valid budget input.
